title: Stay on 30A Property Management: Sea Eagle in Prominence – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: Sea Eagle in Prominence. Stylish & centrally located 3 bed/3 bath townhome in Prominence, perfect for families.
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to 'Sea Eagle' ! A beautifully styled 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhome in the heart of Prominence, designed with families and small groups in mind. From the moment you step inside, you’ll feel right at home with fresh, modern furnishings, an open-concept layout, and thoughtful details that make this space as functional as it is comfortable. The living area flows seamlessly into the gourmet kitchen, complete with high-end appliances and all the essentials needed for everything from a quick breakfast before the beach to a family dinner at home. Each bedroom is outfitted with plush bedding and Smart TVs, ensuring everyone has a cozy retreat of their own after a full day of fun. The location of Sea Eagle is truly hard to beat. Just across the street, you’ll find The Big Chill, a lively gathering spot with restaurants, boutique shopping, family-friendly events, and live music. For a more serene experience, head a short ride away to Deer Lake State Park, where you can walk the boardwalk across untouched dunes and enjoy one of the most pristine stretches of sand along 30A. With a complimentary 6-seater golf cart and 6 adult bikes included with your stay, you’ll have endless opportunities to explore the surrounding communities, trails, and beaches without the hassle of driving. This home is located within Prominence, home to a spectacular 5,000 sq. ft. resort-style pool with cabanas, lounge seating, and plenty of room to soak up the Florida sunshine. For beach days, we’ve got you covered with all the essentials so you can pack light and focus on making memories. Whether you’re planning to spend your mornings biking along scenic 30A, your afternoons exploring nearby state parks, or your evenings enjoying dinner and live music at The Big Chill, Sea Eagle offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and coastal charm. It’s a place where your vacation feels effortless and every detail is designed to help you make the most of your time at the beach. **Sea Eagle will donate a wreath to Wreaths Across America for every stay in the month of June.** TWO STORY UNIT 1st Floor— Garage, Kitchen, Dining Area, Living Room, Half Bath, and Laundry Room 2nd Floor— 3 Bedrooms, 2 Full Baths ACCOMMODATIONS: Sea Eagle comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: Bedroom 1: King, Ensuite. Bedroom 2: Queen. Bedroom 3: Twin/Full Bunk W/ Trundle Bed. **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE:  Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water FEATURES 6 Adult Bikes 6 Seater Golf Cart Resort-Style Community Pool Large Private Patio Fully Stocked Kitchen Drip/Keurig Coffee Maker Full Washer/Dryer Smart TVs Beach Gear PARKING Two driveway parking spaces available. The garage is reserved for the golf cart. For parking additional vehicles, the HOA requires vehicles be parked in the gravel street spaces on the South side of the community. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost. WALKABLE NEIGHBORHOOD AMENITIES -2 Community Pools (heated seasonally October/November & March/April) -Beautiful cabana area with grills -Restaurants, Bars, Ice Cream & Coffee Shops -Shopping -Amphitheater for Live Music, Movies & More -30-A Bicycle Trail PROMINENCE AMENITIES Prominence on 30A is centrally located and has a variety of on-site and close by amenities that make this community one of the most highly sought-after vacation destinations in 30A. This community features incredible amenities such as: 2 community pools and a beautiful cabana area for grilling. *Heated Pool during the months of October, November, March and April* NEARBY BEACH ACCESS -Deer Lake State Park (0.6 miles west of Prominence) is the nearest beach access. This park has great amenities including: restrooms, parking for golf carts/bikes/cars, and a beautiful walk along a boardwalk that winds through the natural dunes leading to the beach. The State Park charges a “Day Use Fee” of $3/car or $2/bikes or pedestrians for access and parking. Alcohol is not allowed as it is a State Park. It is a bit of a longer walk from parking area to the beach, but it’s a beautiful scenic walk on the long boardwalk with white sand dunes. The State Park Beach is less crowded than any public beach access points. - Walton Dunes Beach Access (1.5 miles West of Prominence) has a small parking lot, but no bathrooms, and is located just west of the Deer Lake State Park boundary. This access has no steps-just walk straight onto the beach. One of our personal favorites! -Gulf Lakes Estates is a South Walton County beach access (1 mile east of Prominence). Small access that can be easily missed. Parking not available but easy bike ride to the beach. -Santa Clara is a public beach access located at Bramble Grove Place (about 3.5 miles). This access provides a lifeguard, parking and bathrooms as well as ADA access to the beach. THE BIG CHILL (FORMERLY "THE HUB") The community’s town center, called “The Big Chill,” includes restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater. The amphitheater includes a covered event pavilion and is a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn. This location is perfect for family outings! Be sure to catch the farmer's market here on Thursdays! HOTSPOTS NEARBY The location of Prominence is perfectly placed right in the middle of 30a. Popular spots are a short drive away: Seaside, Watercolor, & Seagrove Beach to the west; Alys Beach, Seacrest, and Rosemary Beach to the east. Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including porch *No parties or events.  *Complimentary golf cart can only be operated by guests over 25 years of age who provide verification. Rental agreement requires a valid drivers license and proof of existing auto insurance coverage. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. read more + less -
